name: Twin Cherries
text: When you play this card, the next time another of your sigils triggers, it triggers twice.

signature.target: your next other sigil to trigger

archetypes: Bonus Chaser, Gold Miner, Diamond Flood, Swap Meet
role: Enabler (doubles one triggered payoff a round)
decision: When to play this card: right before your best trigger, such as a big win payoff, a pass payoff, or a when-played card, rather than ahead of a small one.
opponent: Visible when the doubled sigil resolves; opponents can lead a suit that forces a different next card.
aiNote: Play this card on a trick you expect to lose, when your next likely trigger is worth at least +15 or 20 gold.
rationale: Doubling one triggered payoff is worth about +15 to +30 (a second Crown Jewel or Cracked Safe payout, 20 more gold from Lucky Coin, a second Handshake swap bonus). Always-on sigils don't trigger, so they are unaffected, and a contract multiplier counts once per round however many times its sigil triggers.
deviation: Broadened from the sigil on the next card you play, because most sigils don't trigger when played.
